function.name: omnimemory_track_step
function.description: Log an intermediate thought or execution step out-of-band into Google LevelDB WAL. Shields tokens from the active prompt window to eliminate prompt bloat.

thought.description: Out-of-band chain-of-thought scratchpad, calculations, or notes

function.name: omnimemory_query_scann
function.description: Query Google ScaNN dense vector memory for past concepts, rules, or formulas without inflating the prompt window.

query.description: Natural language or semantic search query

function.name: gomnios_mind4action_cycle
function.description: Execute a 4-stage Mind4Action cognitive cycle (Perceive -> Reflect -> Intend -> Act). Models cognitive ergonomics and logs steps out-of-band.

stimulus.description: The incoming user instruction or goal

function.name: gomnios_department_dispatch
function.description: Dispatch a strategic task to an organizational agent department (Manager, HR, Fullstack, Catalog, Marketing, DevOps).

function.name: omnimemory_trigger_callback
function.description: Send a callback event to activate a ReasoningBank blueprint on the live G-OmniOS web dashboard.
